name: OrthotectModalFSM

closed.description: Modal is hidden from DOM or aria-hidden=true.

opening.description: Entrance transition running (scale/fade spring). Focus lock initiated.

open.description: Active dialog. Focus trapped. Backdrop locked.

submitting.description: Async submit in flight. Secondary actions and backdrop dismiss locked.

successFeedback.description: Submission success feedback before automatic dismissal.

errorFeedback.description: Inline error banner displayed with retry capability. Re-enables interaction.

closing.description: Exit transition running. Restores focus to trigger element.

invariants: Focus MUST be trapped within the modal container while active
Escape key and backdrop click MUST transition to closing state
Submitting state MUST lock interactions against double-submission
On exit, keyboard focus MUST be restored to the invoking element
